claim: Once DivMMC no longer traps RST 38, a game running IM 1 reaches alt-ROM hook space at 0x0038 and 0x386E, so hook code can run or RST 38 can recurse; NextZXOS's trap masks this.

evidence.text: IM 1 in play reaches hook code at 0x386E once DivMMC no longer traps 0x0038 (found with JNext).
evidence.quote: IM 1 in play reaches hook code at 0x386E once DivMMC no longer traps 0x0038 (runs/altrom_audit, JNext; masked under NextZXOS)

evidence.text: Menus run IM 1 into 0xFF bytes (RST 38 recursion) once DivMMC no longer traps 0x0038 (ROM3 of NextZXOS had hooks at 0x386E/0x387E, where the converted ROM has 0xFF); only NextZXOS's trap hid it.
evidence.quote: The menus run IM 1; only NextZXOS's DivMMC trap hid it.

evidence.text: KS1 Issue 2, core 3.03.00 (nxsuite XD3): the delayed RST $38 trap still fired with an alt ROM image in place, so it masks the hook-space path.
